name: the real look's light
about: docs/briefs/red-dead.md R1 (light with shape), DESIGN.md section 4: under the real look only, LightLooks lays night_values over the game's night (light_game.json's, which stay the painted look's) and day_values over its day, and RoomLight is on (its bounce carries the lamps' pools). The saloon at night (2026-11-04 trials, build/r1): light pass round 3's warm wash taken back (the room's fill 0.7 -> 0.25 and neutral, not the lamps' gold; the wall lamps' reach 0.7 -> 0.55, so the sconces' pools part), the grade's lifted blacks gone and light C's cool shadow tint warm (under AgX it turned the floor purple), RoomLight's bounce up (1.5 -> 2.6) and its moonlight in the door and windows down to 0.1 (it washed the floor and the bar lilac); the four lamps hung over the room shaded (RealLook: their tin shade casts a shadow, real.hung_*) and brighter and reaching the floor, a pool under each with the chairs' shadows in it and the ceiling over them dark (the saloon_hanging dials reach only the porch lantern); the lamps' haze at light C's (0.6: at 1-2.5 every sconce was a blot) in a thin room haze (0.08). The street by day: haze down the street (fog x2.2, a little of the sky's colour in it), the shade's bounce from SDFGI and the sky's fill down, ambient occlusion in the sun (contact shadows).
